summary: Presents a winner already provided by the application, or an empty-state message.
whenToUse: Prominently displaying the result of a draw.
Pairing with RaffleDraw to show the winner's details.
whenNotToUse: Choosing or animating a random selection.
Managing participant data or persisting the outcome.

props.name: winner
props.description: External winner data; null shows the empty state.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when winner is null.

inherits: HTML attributes of <section>. RaffleWinner: id, name, entryNumber?, detail?, avatar?.
accessibility: The section is named by its heading and the empty message uses role=status.
The avatar or icon is decorative; the winner's name is text.
responsive: Long names and details wrap without shrinking the icon.
customization: Uses the theme's --dc-* tokens; className and HTML attributes are forwarded.
commonMistakes: Using WinnerReveal as a draw engine: the winner must be passed in by the caller.
limits: Does not select or persist winners.
